newsitem.title: PERU: Mobil to invest $10 mln in Peru gasoline sector.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to invest $10 mln in Peru gasoline sector.

text.p: U.S. firm Mobil Corp's Peruvian susidiary, Mobil Oil de Peru, plans to invest around $10 million next year in the local gasoline market, company spokesman John McCaffrey said Wednesday.
McCaffrey also told reporters at an oil conference in Lima that by the end of 1996 Mobil will have invested $80 million in the sector.
Mobil has around 120 gasoline stations in Peru, 20 more than it aimed for when it entered the market in 1994.
It competes in Peru with the Anglo-Dutch Royal Dutch/Shell, the United State's Texaco Inc, and Argentina's YPF. Spain's Repsol SA is also starting to enter the market.
McCaffrey did not give more details of Mobil's 1997 investment plans in Peru, but he has said previously that Mobil's focus here is "to affiliate existing sites, not develop new sites."
